Both are presidential letters prompted by a newly approved statute; each explains why the statute's authority should be administered cautiously, directs an executive official to develop an implementation program, specifically protects small businesses against disadvantage relative to larger firms, and requires interagency coordination. This combination is substantially more concrete and distinctive than a shared general administrative function. C14 parallels the child’s study-and-report instruction, while C03 parallels directed planning, coordination, and reporting, but neither matches the child’s procurement and small-business machinery as closely as C11.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Pursuant to the authority of the new Act, I hereby designate you... The Act requires that a fair proportion of all procurement shall be placed with small business concerns.","parent_excerpt":"Section 18(h) of the Selective Service Act of 1948, which I approved on June 24, 1948, authorizes the President...","explanation":"Both letters begin from authority created by a recently approved statute and explain how that authority should be implemented administratively."},{"child_excerpt":"There is always the danger that the natural desire for flexibility and speed in procurement may lead to excessive placement of contracts by negotiations and undue reliance upon large concerns. This must not occur.","parent_excerpt":"In setting up this program, it is essential that adequate provision be made to insure that small businesses are in a position to bid on orders for the Armed Forces on equal terms with larger producers","explanation":"Both identify the same concrete procurement concern: preserving opportunities for small businesses against larger firms while administering newly available authority."},{"child_excerpt":"I am therefore asking you to undertake a study looking toward the issuance of detailed standards to guide procurement officers...","parent_excerpt":"Instead, I am asking you to proceed immediately to develop a voluntary allocations program...","explanation":"The operative drafting pattern is parallel: after explaining why direct or unrestricted use of statutory authority is undesirable, the President asks the addressee to develop a more carefully structured implementation program."},{"child_excerpt":"In order to make this policy uniform in the Federal Government, I am asking you to make an annual report...","parent_excerpt":"It is highly desirable that all governmental operations relating to allocations of steel be concentrated in a single agency, and that the several allocation programs be coordinated and integrated into a single, overall program.","explanation":"Both seek uniform, coordinated administration across federal operations rather than fragmented agency practice."}]}
